title: Distinct Subsequences
summary: Count the ways to strike letters out of a text so that a given word is left, in order.
followUps: What if the count could be far larger than 2^31 and had to be reported modulo 10^9 + 7?
What if text were a million letters long and word only a few letters?
What if the letters of word had to sit side by side in text?
